rationale: The persona prizes scope-discipline and conservative, well-founded claims. Option 1 ties the necessity claim to the specific inferential links argued and scopes it to the evaluations studied, matching their preference for hedged, delimited assertions. Option 2's clean necessary-but-not-sufficient framing is also rigorous and appeals to their love of precise distinctions, but makes a broader unscoped necessity claim, so it is less favored.
